steps.user_message: I joined a yoga retreat with my friend Emma last weekend, and it was a rejuvenating experience practicing in such a serene environment.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I joined a yoga retreat with my friend Emma last weekend, and it was a rejuvenating experience practicing in such a serene environment.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — glad you had a rejuvenating weekend. Would you like help turning that into an email or message to Emma (or the retreat organizer)?

Here are three short sample emails you can use — tell me which one to send or draft and to whom (I can send it now or save as a draft):

1) Short thank-you (casual)
Subject: Loved the retreat!
Body: Hi Emma — I had such a wonderful time at the retreat with you last weekend. Practicing in that serene setting felt so rejuvenating. Thank you for joining me — let’s plan another getaway soon! Love, [Your name]

2) Longer recap + suggestion to plan again
Subject: Retreat recap — let’s do it again!
Body: Hi Emma — I’m still buzzing from last weekend. The classes, the setting, and our long chats made it exactly what I needed. Would you be up for planning another retreat later this year? Maybe someplace coastal? I’d love to start looking at dates. xo, [Your name]

3) Share photos / ask for hers
Subject: Photos from the retreat
Body: Hey Emma — I’ve uploaded a few photos from the retreat and wanted to share them with you. Do you have any you can send me? I’d love to put together a little album of our weekend. — [Your name]

Tell me:
- Which message you want (1, 2, or 3) or if you want a different tone;
- Whether to send now or save as a draft;
- The recipient email (Emma’s address) or confirm I should find an email in your inbox.
